t: The prayer that was interrupted by a verse
a: اللَّهُمَّ الْعَنْ أَبَا سُفْيَانَ اللَّهُمَّ الْعَنِ الْحَارِثَ بْنَ هِشَامٍ اللَّهُمَّ الْعَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنَ أُمَيَّةَ
p: Allāhumma-lʿan Abā Sufyān, Allāhumma-lʿani-l-Ḥāritha-bna Hishām, Allāhumma-lʿan Ṣafwāna-bna Umayyah
m: O Allah, curse Abu Sufyan. O Allah, curse al-Harith ibn Hisham. O Allah, curse Safwan ibn Umayyah.
